name: crypt-sync
description: Keep .env and secret files encrypted in git, synced across machines via age — the agent layer (Claude Code and Codex) over the crypt-sync CLI

interface.shortDescription: Encrypted .env files in git, synced across machines
interface.longDescription: Decision layer over the crypt-sync npm CLI: encrypts secret files with age, commits the .age blobs, and decrypts them on pull. Gates every crypt-sync command on the CLI being installed and never handles your passphrase.
defaultPrompt: Why did git pull not decrypt my secrets?
Set up crypt-sync on this new machine
